name: Triad Plastic Technologies
old_description: Since 1988, Triad has specialized in delivering complete plastic solutions, offering services including rapid prototyping, mold design and construction, precision plastic injection molding, product assembly, packaging, and logistics. Whether you’re launching a new product or scaling production, we provide end-to-end support under one roof.
about:
Triad Plastic Technologies was founded in 1988 in Reno, Nevada. The company operates as a U.S.-based manufacturer, keeping all production in-house to protect intellectual property and maintain quality control.

Triad provides end-to-end plastic solutions, including rapid prototyping, mold design and construction, precision plastic injection molding, clean room molding, product assembly, decorating, packaging, and logistics. Its molding machines use all-electric, servo-driven CNC technology, while mold making employs CNC machining centers and CNC-EDM machines. The company also handles tooling repair, optimization, and maintenance.

The company serves medical and industrial OEM customers. Its services support product launches and high-volume production runs. A testimonial from Jonathan and Nicole highlights the firm's collaborative approach.

Triad differentiates itself by performing every step domestically, refusing to outsource overseas, and signing non-disclosure agreements to secure client designs. In 2023 it received the Manufacturing Excellence for Small Business Award from EDAWN, recognizing its commitment to American manufacturing standards.

name: Trickett Woodworks Co
old_description: Trickett Woodworks Co. was founded in 1975 and is located in Auburn, New Hampshire.  We are family owned and service New England, New York and points beyond. Our products have been installed throughout the country.
about:
Trickett Woodworks Co. was founded in 1975 in Auburn, New Hampshire, and remains a family-owned operation serving New England, New York, and beyond. The company’s products have been installed throughout the country.

The firm operates a 10,000-square-foot production shop where it performs all millwork and finishing in-house. Its capabilities span architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, custom woodwork, trim, moldings, built-in cabinetry, and finish carpentry, supported by estimating and project management services. The shop handles projects from concept to completion, ensuring precision and reliability for each client.

Trickett Woodworks works with general contractors, architects, designers, and property owners across commercial, residential, healthcare, hospitality, and corporate sectors. Project examples include a Boston professional office, a healthcare facility, a corporate café, a hotel pub, residential kitchens, and corporate reception areas.

The company emphasizes its ability to tackle challenging designs and deliver custom finishes on schedule, a reputation recognized by a 2022 Boston Society of Architects Award. General Manager Charlie Trickett oversees operations.

name: Trim Illusion Inc
old_description: Discover a new level of refinement with our exclusive automobile trim. Our patented products are designed and tested in the US, to make your vehicle truly unique. Elevate your ride and stand out on the road.
about:
Based in Bowie, Maryland, Trim Illusion Inc designs and tests its patented automobile trim products in the United States. The company focuses on aftermarket chrome-delete overlays that give vehicles a custom, high-end appearance without the cost of full refinishing.

Trim Illusion produces a range of snap-on trim components including wheel covers, wheel skins, grille overlays, mirror covers, door-handle covers, emblem overlays, window trims, and tailgate moldings. The parts are molded from ABS plastic with a gloss-black finish and are sold as vehicle-specific kits for makes such as Chevrolet, GMC, Ford, Toyota, and more than a dozen other brands. The company also offers complete body kits that modify the entire exterior with a single purchase.

The business serves both professional automotive shops and individual vehicle owners. Its website notes a "Professional Automotive Shop Approved" designation, and customer reviews reference installations on models like the 2020 Chevy Blazer, 2021 Tahoe RST, and 2026 Honda Pilot. Products are shipped directly to consumers and through the company's online store.

Trim Illusion says its differentiation lies in U.S.-based design and testing of patented products, promising a unique look that stands out on the road. The company emphasizes easy, tape-assisted installation and responsive customer support when fitment issues arise.

name: Trivium Packaging
old_description: Content on this website may not be accurately translated due to the limitations of the translation software from Google Translate. The official text is the English language version of the website. Any discrepancies or differences created in the translation are not binding and have no legal effect. If questions arise in relation to the accuracy of the information mentioned on the translated website, please refer to the English version of the website.
about:
Trivium Packaging, headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia, was founded in 2001. The company operates as a global manufacturer of metal packaging, with 57 locations worldwide and approximately 7,200 employees generating annual revenue of about $3 billion.

The company produces a wide range of metal packaging including two-piece and three-piece cans, aerosols, threaded bottles, beverage bottles, and slugs, ends, and components. Its shaping technologies encompass mechanical expansion, impact extrusion, and blow moulding, complemented by advanced graphic design and printing capabilities. Research and development facilities in France and the United States support innovations such as the Tripod can, SpringLatch closure system, and Easy Peel opening solution.

Trivium serves diverse industries: food (seafood, vegetables, wet and dry products), beverages (water, soft drinks, beer, wine, spirits), coffee (ready-to-drink, instant, ground, beans), beauty and personal care (body sprays, washes, lotions, hair products), health and nutrition (vitamins, supplements, OTC, prescription drugs, infant formula), pet (pet food, care, health), paints and coatings (liquid and aerosol spray paints), and home care and industrial (household cleaners, industrial disinfectants, automotive care). Its customers include global brands seeking sustainable packaging.

The company differentiates itself through a focus on circularity—metal packaging that is infinitely recyclable without quality loss—and an Operational Excellence program that drives continuous efficiency improvements. Trivium also offers end-to-end support from graphics and design through certification, compliance, technical consultancy, and training, backed by more than 25 years of experience in packaging innovation.

name: TruNorth Solar
old_description: Since 2009, we’ve been actively involved in Minnesota solar power trade organizations and associations and the only solar provider in Minnesota that is a member of Amicus, an invitation-only national solar co-op with the best independent solar companies across the country.
about:
TruNorth Solar is a Minnesota-based solar contractor headquartered in Roseville, founded in 2009 by Marty Morud. The company traces its origins to a family farm in Bemidji where Morud, along with college roommate Steve and business partner Dave, built their first array for Morud’s father. After buying out his partners in 2013, Morud became sole owner and grew the business into a full-service installer serving residential, commercial, and agricultural clients across Minnesota and western Wisconsin.

The firm designs and installs photovoltaic systems ranging from rooftop residential arrays to large-scale commercial and agricultural projects, and has completed more than 1,200 installations totaling 26 megawatts of community solar and over 110 commercial arrays. A staff of roughly 30 employees handles every phase in‑house — engineering, permitting, incentive paperwork, interconnection, construction, and commissioning — and operates a dedicated “Life of System” service department that maintains and repairs any solar or storage system regardless of original installer.

Customers include homeowners seeking lower electric bills, businesses leveraging grants such as Xcel Energy’s Solar*Rewards and C‑PACE financing, and farms pursuing energy resilience and property‑value gains. TruNorth also develops community solar gardens that allow subscribers to offset utility costs without on‑site equipment.

Morud frames the company’s mission around environmental stewardship and “honest handshakes,” emphasizing that savings extend beyond money. Membership in the Amicus Solar Cooperative — an invitation‑only national network of independent installers — provides collective buying power and continuous best‑practice sharing, and TruNorth remains the only Amicus member installer in Minnesota.

name: Truck & Transportation Equipment Company
old_description: In business since 1967, Truck and Transportation Equipment Company is a final stage truck manufacturer providing the southern part of the country top quality truck equipment. We transform your incomplete cab and chassis – of any model truck – to a finished vehicle, customized to meet your exact requirements.
about:
Truck & Transportation Equipment Company has operated from Jefferson, Louisiana, since 1967. The business began as a final-stage truck manufacturer, taking incomplete cab-and-chassis units of any make and completing them as customized work trucks for customers across the southern United States.

The company's eight-acre campus on Industrial Avenue includes seven buildings straddling the street: a main shop with twelve work bays, a quick-get-ready shop with five bays, a separate heavy-fabrication shop equipped with metal brakes, shears, and gantry cranes, a full paint shop, and multiple parts and storage buildings. The fabrication shop can produce any truck body a customer requires, while the service department runs twenty-seven full bays for repairs and warranty work. A large on-site inventory supports its role as a Louisiana distributor for major truck-equipment brands.

Customers range from commercial fleets and construction firms to government agencies, municipalities, and first-responder organizations. The company supplies fire and EMS apparatus, police and emergency lighting from Federal Signal, and a sandbagging attachment that mounts to construction vehicles. Its parts counter serves cargo vans, light-, medium-, and heavy-duty trucks, and tractor-trailers.

The firm emphasizes continuity after delivery, maintaining a service-after-the-sale model backed by a sales team with a collective 150 years of industry experience. Financing options are also offered for new equipment purchases.

name: True South Solar
old_description: True South Solar has been installing solar for commercial clients since 2010. We install both solar panels and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for commercial clients. Work with True South Solar today and enjoy energy independence, reduced bills, and the confidence of being prepared for emergencies.
about:
True South Solar was founded in 2010 in Ashland, Oregon. The company began as a solar installation provider for Southern Oregon residents and businesses, establishing itself as a local installer focused on renewable energy solutions.

The company provides commercial solar installations, battery energy storage systems (BESS), feasibility studies, tax credit and incentive filing, solar expansions, service agreements, monitoring support, panel removal and replacement, and warranty claim assistance. Its in-house team handles design through installation, and it partners with ELM Microgrid Solutions for commercial-scale storage. The firm has served thousands of customers across the region over more than 15 years.

True South Solar works with commercial businesses, schools, and nonprofits seeking on-site renewable energy. Clients include organizations with flat roofs or unused land looking to reduce energy costs, gain backup power, or meet sustainability goals. The company also assists with grant funding from the Energy Trust of Oregon and federal REAP grants.

The company says it is driven by a vision of a Net-Zero Rogue Valley and values such as empowering change, sustainability in action, safety first, unwavering integrity, innovation, and creating meaningful careers. It emphasizes local roots, transparent processes, and long-term client relationships.

name: TrueChoicePack
old_description: A total solutions provider for private label and custom disposable products! TrueChoicePack offers innovative and sustainable solutions to Fortune 500 retailers across America. We would love to work with you to build your private label or add our excellent in-house brands to your product assortment!
about:
TrueChoicePack was founded in 2013 in West Chester Township, Ohio. The company began as a total solutions provider for private label and customized disposable products, working with retailers, distributors, and food service partners from concept to delivery.

The company develops and supplies a broad portfolio of disposable products, including compostable cutlery, plates, bowls, food containers, trash can liners, and aluminum foil. Its in-house brands—Progress, BioGreenChoice, and EcoWay—cover everyday essentials, sustainable foodservice solutions, and tree-free paper products made from bamboo and sugarcane fiber. TrueChoicePack operates an agile manufacturing network that leverages multiple pre-qualified manufacturing partners across key regions, supported by global operations with offices in the United States and India and a network of warehouses and factories. The firm handles product development, global sourcing, quality management, warehousing, and distribution, working with materials such as bagasse, bamboo, birchwood, PLA, CPLA, PHA, polypropylene, polystyrene, polyethylene, and low-density polyethylene.

TrueChoicePack serves retail, foodservice, wholesale, commercial, and government customers, including Fortune 500 retailers. Its private label programs provide both eco-friendly and traditional product lines tailored to each client’s specifications.

The company differentiates itself through its agile manufacturing model, which enables rapid volume shifts and supply route reconfiguration, and through proactive compliance monitoring of evolving regulations across states and countries. It maintains certifications including BPI, FDA food-safe, ISO, UL, SGS, and BRC, and employs an in-house R&D team led by PhD biochemists and supply chain engineers.

name: Tulsa Plastics Co
old_description: For over 70 years, Tulsa Plastics Company has been setting itself apart from the competition by providing our valued customers with the industry’s most innovative products, CNC technology, and unparalleled customer service.
about:
Tulsa Plastics Company was founded in 1941 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, initially producing plastic covers for household water coolers. Within months the family-owned business pivoted to manufacturing parts for the World War II effort, establishing a foundation in precision fabrication that continues today.

The company operates as a full-line plastics distributor and fabricator, offering waterjet cutting, CNC routing, milling, and lathe turning with live tooling, custom tape converting, CNC saw cut-to-size, diamond edge polishing, and heat bending. Its equipment includes CNC routers, waterjets, CNC panel saws, a diamond edge polisher, and a heat bender, enabling production of parts from plastics, composites, and metals for both prototype and production volumes.

Tulsa Plastics serves aerospace, chemical, oil and gas, food processing, retail, and convenience-store sectors, supplying materials such as acrylic, polycarbonate, Kydex, specialty tapes, masking films, window films, adhesives, and aerospace laminates. It is an authorized distributor for major manufacturers including Evonik, 3M, Covestro, and Kydex, and machines components for several Fortune 500 companies.

The firm differentiates itself by holding both AS9100 and ISO 9001 certifications, a combination it says is rare among plastics companies, and by emphasizing quick turnaround times and competitive pricing across small-quantity and large-run orders.

name: Tulsa Sheet Metal
old_description: Complete your project on time, every time with custom fabrication and versatile metalwork from Tulsa Sheet Metal in Oklahoma. Since 1949, we have provided commercial and industrial clients nationwide with only the best products.
about:
Tulsa Sheet Metal operates from Tulsa, Oklahoma, where it has been in business since 1949. The company does not publicly identify its founders or specify an ownership structure such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication with a range of CNC and manual processes: shearing, punching, burning, forming, bending, pressing, stamping, welding, repair, rolling, sawing, cutting, drilling, grinding, polishing, and painting, plus assembly and subassembly. An in-house engineer assists with custom designs. The facility is described as fully equipped for high-capacity orders using larger, heavier, and thicker materials, and works with aluminum, stainless steel, copper, brass, and alloy in sheet, plate, or structural shapes. Materials can be supplied by the shop or shipped directly by the customer.

The company serves commercial and industrial clients across the United States. No specific industry verticals or named customers are disclosed in its public materials.

Tulsa Sheet Metal emphasizes its combined 90 years of metalworking experience and the goal of meeting each customer's fabrication needs as its primary differentiators.
